recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone composition featuring a teal-colored stippled texture that depicts ancient-style petroglyphs of human and animal figures on a light mint background, overlaid with geometric red typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Teal stippled texture against a pale mint base
Red geometric typography contrasting with the cool-toned background
Primitive line-art figures integrated into a gritty, stone-like texture
Right-aligned text block balancing the central vertical figure
coreInvariants: Duo-tone teal/mint color palette for the imagery
Specific 'E' character with three disconnected horizontal bars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, stylized central figure with a circular head dominates the center-right; smaller figures are scattered to the left and top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central petroglyph figure provides the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red text in the top right, moves down the central figure, and then scans the smaller figures on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The light mint background acts as negative space, though it is heavily textured with fine teal dots.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal (used for all illustrative texture and shading)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale Mint (used as the base paper/background color)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation cool tones for the background; medium-saturation warm tone for the text to create a focal point.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to three primary ink colors

letterConstructionRules: Disconnected horizontal bars in the letter 'E'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' consists of a vertical stem and three floating horizontal dashes
The 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a very low, stylized one
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric base for the 'M' and 'W' shapes.
Captures the circular geometry and 1970s/80s aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured background in pale mint and teal. Use a stippling effect to create primitive petroglyph shapes including a large central figure with a ringed head and smaller animal/human figures. The texture should look like a weathered stone surface or a screen print on rough paper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of right-aligned, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner. Use a muted red color. Modify the letter 'E' to have three separate horizontal bars.

verificationChecks: Is the 'E' character modified with floating bars?
Is the background limited to teal and mint stippling?
Are the petroglyphs primitive in style?

mustRedesign: The specific arrangement of the petroglyphs to avoid direct copying
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Check that no black ink is present
Ensure the texture feels like a physical print
Verify the red text is legible against the teal background
recipe.reuseFormula: Stippled primitive illustration + Geometric modified sans-serif + Duo-tone cool palette with warm accent
